how_to_run: Run inside a BB thread as a dry run: append 'Dry run: do not spawn threads, send messages or write files; list the exact commands, file contents, one full worker brief, and your end-of-turn message.' Run with-skill and baseline (no skill) in fresh sessions. Grade the transcript against the assertions.

evals.name: new-workstream
evals.prompt: ok so i want you to be the coordinator for the bb-plugins repo (~/src/bb-plugins). theres a few things going on: the cache-hits plugin tests are flaky, focus needs a proper README, we should bump @get-bb/plugin-sdk across every plugin, and the cost plugin's price fetch keeps failing and i dont know why. i'll be in and out today so run it and ping me when you need me
evals.expected_output: Creates .coordinator/<workstream>.md before spawning, spawns parented workers with --parent-notifications stuck, and every worker brief ends with the single bb thread tell report contract.
assertions: Creates or plans .coordinator/<workstream>.md (workers, decided-by-default, open calls, next) before any spawn
The worker brief tells the worker to report once via bb thread tell <coordinator> --mode queue, with outcome, files, checks marked passed/failed/skipped, decisions and questions
The worker brief says questions go through bb thread tell, not only in the final reply
Long or repeated verification (for example looping flaky tests) is delegated to a worker or child, not run in the coordinator

evals.name: take-over-stale-coordinator
evals.prompt: the old coordinator thread for my dotfiles stuff got massive and confused (like 400+ messages), its thr_OLD123 (made up id, assume it exists). take over as coordinator - there were 3 worker threads under it still doing things i think. also one of them asked me whether to drop the tmux config entirely or keep it and i never answered. just pick it up and keep going
evals.expected_output: Stops (does not archive) the old coordinator, rebuilds the state file from a bounded read, reparents workers with --parent-notifications stuck, re-sends the report contract with the new coordinator id, and records the tmux question as an open call rather than deciding deletion.
assertions: Reads the old thread with a bounded log read, not the full history
Stops the old coordinator with bb thread stop and does not archive it
Reparents each worker with bb thread update <w> --parent-thread <me> --parent-notifications stuck
Tells each worker the new report address with the report contract
Does not choose to delete the tmux config; records it as an open call (keeping it as a reversible default is fine)

evals.name: should-not-coordinate-single-task
evals.prompt: can you just fix the typo in the focus plugin README, it says 'thead' instead of 'thread' somewhere
evals.expected_output: Fixes the typo directly in the current thread. No state file, no child threads.
assertions: Does the edit itself without spawning a child thread
